content:
name: on-push-or-release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  release:
    types: [created]
  # manual retry, e.g. when a publish failed after master was already bumped
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-lint-test:
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build-lint-test.yml
    secrets: inherit

  coverage:
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    needs:
      - build-lint-test
    uses: ./.github/workflows/publish-coverage.yml
    secrets: inherit

  publish-alpha:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]' && github.actor != 'mergify[bot]'
    needs:
      - build-lint-test
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/publish-alpha.yml
    secrets: inherit

  publish-with-git-tag-version:
    if: github.event_name == 'release' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/publish-with-git-tag-version.yml
    secrets: inherit
